description_en: Updates the members of a resource
kebab_example: aliyun devops update-resource-member --organization-id 5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx --resource-type pipeline --role-name admin --resource-id 111111 --account-id 11111 --api-version 2021-06-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateResourceMember

parameters.help_en: The organization ID. You can obtain this string value from the Yunxiao URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrganizationId]
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Valid values: pipeline and hostGroup
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型 pipeline 流水线  hostGroup 主机组
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The role name. Valid values for a host group (hostGroup):
user: Member. Has usage permissions.
admin: Administrator. Has edit permissions.
owner: Owner. Has all permissions.
Valid values for a pipeline (pipeline):
owner: Owner. Has all permissions.
admin: Administrator. Has view, run, and edit permissions.
member: Member. Has run permissions.
viewer: Viewer. Has view permissions
parameters.help_zh:
角色部署组 hostGroup 

user 成员，使用权限 

admin 管理员，使用编辑权限

owner 拥有者，所有权限 

流水线 pipeline 

owner 拥有者，所有权限

admin  查看、运行、编辑权限

member 运行权限 

viewer 查看权限
parameters.name: role_name
